unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U24: Assess leases,notice defaults and leasehold collateral

payload.title: Read the lease before applying a notice default
payload.core_explanation_md:
A lease gives the right to enjoy property for the stated duration and consideration, while ownership and possession remain distinct. The source section 106 defaults apply in the absence of a contrary contract, local law or usage: agricultural/manufacturing leases are year-to-year with six-month notice, and the other described category is month-to-month with fifteen-day notice. Notice receipt, form and statutory qualifications matter. These are not universal periods overriding every lease.

Registration requirements and State law need checking. For leasehold security, examine remaining term, mortgage permission, lessor consent, forfeiture risk and any appropriate tripartite arrangement. A long-lived structure or an heirs clause alone does not settle permanent-tenure status; interpret the complete lease.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a lender ignore a shorter unexpired lease because the asset valuation is high?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Duration and enforceability affect the collateral interest.

payload.stem_md: A lease contains express termination provisions, but the reviewer automatically substitutes the section 106 default without reading them. What is wrong?

options.text_md: The default is subject to the relevant contract, local law or usage
No lease can contain termination terms
options.explanation_md: A lease can contain relevant termination terms; the section 106 default expressly requires checking for a contrary contract.

options.text_md: Only the rent payment method matters

payload.stem_md: A proposed secured loan runs beyond the borrower remaining lease term. Which issue requires attention?

options.text_md: Only whether the borrower has a current account
options.explanation_md: That does not solve tenure risk.
Physical condition is not the only risk.

options.text_md: The duration, transfer permission and enforcement value of the leasehold interest
options.explanation_md: The bank must assess the interest that can actually secure repayment.

options.text_md: A presumption that every lease automatically renews forever

payload.correct_explanation_md: The bank must assess the interest that can actually secure repayment.
